findings.evidence: `grep -n "K\.EPS|\.EPS\b" EpsilonEridani/` → no matches. `PolarizedKinematics` at Polarized/Kinematics.lean:66 already supplies `S`, `spin_orthogonal`, `spin_normalized` over `DisKinematics`.
findings.fix: Delete `SpinKinematics` and take `K : PolarizedKinematics g` with `EPS` as a parameter, matching `Leptonic.lMuNuOdd (ε : V [⋀^Fin 4]→ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (K : DisKinematics V)` at Tensors/Basic.lean:261. (If the orientation is genuinely meant to be bundled, do it the other way: keep the record, drop the `EPS` parameters and write `K.EPS` — but do not carry both.)
findings.issue: `SpinKinematics g` duplicates `PolarizedKinematics g` (Polarized/Kinematics.lean:66): its only new field, `EPS`, is never read — every declaration (lines 89, 97, 108, 113, 118, 123, 128, 133, 155, 167, 173) takes `EPS` as a separate explicit argument and uses `K` only for `p`, `q`, `S`, `M2`, `xBj`, `Q2`, all inherited. The structure, its `@[ext]`, and its projection surface are dead weight.

findings.evidence: Lines 157-158 and 169 are the same linear combination; lines 177-178 repeat the coefficients of 157-158 literally.
findings.fix: Define the predicate through the constructor: `A = fromAlternatingCoefficients EPS K (√(K.M2 g) / g K.p K.q * G.g1 (K.xBj g) (K.Q2 g)) ((√(K.M2 g))⁻¹ / g K.p K.q * G.g2 (K.xBj g) (K.Q2 g))`; the characterising lemma stays `rfl` and the coefficients are written once.
findings.issue: `IsPolarizedAlternatingDecomposition` (lines 157-158) re-derives the body of `fromAlternatingCoefficients` (line 169) rather than using it: both spell `c₁ • structureOne + c₂ • structureTwo`, and the same coefficient expressions are written a third time at lines 177-178. `fromAlternatingCoefficients_isDecomposition` is `rfl` only because the expression is duplicated verbatim, so it proves nothing about the constructor.

findings.evidence: `grep -n IsPolarizedDecomposition code/` → one hit, `Polarized/Basic.lean:178` (the definition itself).
findings.fix: Either prove the characterisation the roadmap requires (`SpinStructure/README.md` §0.2: `IsPolarizedDecomposition` holds iff `A = 0` or `g₁ x Q² + g₂ x Q² = 1`, "stated as a lemma so that no later result quietly depends on the weaker predicate"), or delete `IsPolarizedDecomposition` outright — the no-compat policy permits removing the obsolete surface since it has no uses.
findings.issue: Parallel API: `Polarized.IsPolarizedDecomposition` (Polarized/Basic.lean:178) is already a decomposition predicate over the same `(G : StructureFunctions) (A : Bilin V)` data and has no consumer anywhere; this PR adds a second, near-identically named predicate in the same namespace with no relation stated between them.

summary: The new `SpinKinematics` record duplicates the existing `PolarizedKinematics` — its only added field `EPS` is never read anywhere, while every declaration takes `EPS` as a separate parameter. The decomposition predicate also restates the body of `fromAlternatingCoefficients` instead of using it, and it is introduced beside the existing `IsPolarizedDecomposition` with no stated relation.
